items: SubTexture: Represents a sub-region within a parent texture/image (Texture Atlas Frame). Designed to act as a transparent wrapper around a sub-rectangle of a larger image, supporting zero-copy GPU UV remapping as well as lazy bitmap cropping.

SubTexture
Class

Represents a sub-region within a parent texture/image (Texture Atlas Frame). Designed to act as a transparent wrapper around a sub-rectangle of a larger image, supporting zero-copy GPU UV remapping as well as lazy bitmap cropping.
